P4.rule: plot.outcome: each of the two steps (odd to sum2, sum2 to sum3) is 'fall' if the value drops by at least the bar, 'rise' if it grows by at least the bar, else 'level' (share: step_bar on the rescaled share; probes: probe_bar on accuracy). Share shape: 'out of order' if any step rises, 'falls' if both fall, 'flat' if both are level, else 'partial'. Tracking: 'tracks both probes' if the share's steps equal both probes' steps, 'tracks the MLP probe' if they equal the MLP's only, 'mirrors the linear probe only' if they equal the linear's only, else 'tracks neither'
P4.claim: card rival a: the share falls at both steps, in the same steps as the MLP probe (shape 'falls' and share steps equal to the MLP's)
P4.rival_b: card rival b: shape 'flat' or 'out of order', or the share's steps equal the linear probe's and not the MLP's
P4.neither: any other pattern (for example 'partial' with steps matching no probe) is reported as read, with the steps
P4.expected: two sites is where the ladder can show a fall at both steps (sum2 sits at 0.59 rescaled). At one site the sum-of-two rung already reads 0.07 above the floor, so its second step can be a 'fall' only if the sum of three reads under the floor by 0.03 or more: at one site 'partial' (fall, level) is the expected shape whatever the share measures, and it is read as that floor effect, not as evidence against rival a
